title: Fix three bugs in a Go binary search implementation
description: A Go binary search package has three bugs: BinarySearch uses wrong mid formula (integer overflow risk), the loop condition misses equality, and FirstOccurrence returns mid instead of tracking the best answer.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix two bugs in search.go:
1. `BinarySearch`: change `lo < hi` to `lo <= hi` in the loop condition so the last element is reachable
2. `FirstOccurrence`: replace `return mid` with `result = mid; hi = mid - 1` so it continues searching left for the earliest occurrence
All 2 test functions must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `go test ./...` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
